scope.description: Implicit automatic joint transitions, with legal serialized RawNode application, failed transient leadership transfer, continuing ticks, prompt persistence/application and reliable quorum communication after the dropped transfer request.
assumptions: No crashes or storage failures; caller completes Ready persistence and application before Advance.
Both joint majorities remain responsive and same leader remains authoritative.
No further configuration requests or ordinary client proposals are supplied during the observation interval.
excluded: Explicit joint transitions whose exit belongs to the caller.
Permanent quorum loss, successful leadership transfer, or caller failure to process Ready.
A universal numeric completion deadline or proof of all-history liveness.
Consensus safety, client data loss and availability consequences beyond joint-state retention.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: In-package reads expose state and counters only; target logic is unchanged.
Transport drops only emitted TimeoutNow; storage and application are supplied synchronously by the harness.
Genesis snapshot at index/term 1 represents a preconfigured cluster, consistent with RawNode bootstrap guidance.

plan_uncertainties: No numeric automatic-exit deadline appears in the API; the finite comparison is not by itself an unbounded liveness violation.
Term and leader continuity, transfer expiration, heartbeat counts and draining diagnostics must be inspected in checker correspondence rather than silently used to discard observations.
The check covers synchronous Ready/Advance and a failed transfer, not asynchronous storage or successful transfer.
grounding_unresolved: The API gives no numeric deadline; any finite final-state comparison has that limitation and must not be reported as an unconditional eventual-liveness proof.
No application state machine beyond ordered configuration application is modeled; only configuration completion is claimed.

Forty ticks is a fixed observation horizon, not a protocol-specified deadline. Attribution to lost autonomous work needs source correspondence: ordinary heartbeat and timeout paths cannot supply appliedTo once committed work is drained.
